    "Reliable performance with good security"

  "cons": [
    "Limited customization options for specific workflows",
    "Fickle copy/paste functionality can be frustrating",
    "Lack of an auto-save feature requires constant manual saving"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Account Manager found Smartsheet to be a generally effective tool for tracking goods arrival times within their medical devices company. While appreciating its core project management capabilities and reliability, they likely encountered frustrations with certain functional limitations. The limited customization and small usability issues like copy/paste and lack of auto-save detracted from an otherwise positive experience, leading to a moderately satisfied but not enthusiastic recommendation."
